title: Qualitative Analysis of Organic Compounds
notes: **Lassaigne's test:** convert covalently bonded N, S, or halogen into ionic form by fusing the organic compound with Na metal. The fused extract is tested.

**Sulphur test:** extract + $Na_2[Fe(CN)_5NO]$ â†’ purple colour confirms sulphur. Also: extract + $Pb(Ac)_2$ â†’ black $PbS$ precipitate.
**Halogen test:** extract + dilute $HNO_3$ + $AgNO_3$ â†’ precipitate: white ($AgCl$, Cl), pale yellow ($AgBr$, Br), yellow ($AgI$, I).
**Reason for fusion:** organic compounds contain N, S, X as covalent bonds. Na converts them to water-soluble ionic sodium salts: $Na + C + N \rightarrow NaCN$.
